text:
Asha: Quick thread to settle Waypoint DP plan: incentives, intake, and a deterministic feedback -> backlog mapping. Goal: 4 external partners in 9 weeks.
Ben: Love that. Can we keep incentives predictable for finance?
Asha: Draft tiers: Seed = early access + docs; Pilot = $3k credits + 6 office hours; Partner = $15k credits + 25h SRE + prioritization slot + anonymized case study. Partner needs 6-week stability commit.
Cal: For private/VPC installs add a one-time ops stipend ($5k) for Partner and require runbook sign-off.
Dina: Intake should capture data_classification, KMS_needed (y/n), logs_allowed (y/n), and whether partner needs an NDA addendum. Also want a checkbox for anonymized case study consent.
dp-bot: Waypoint intake form live: https://internal.redwood/dp/waypoint (auto-tag: dp/waypoint) :white_check_mark:
Jamal: Feedback capture: require reproducible (y/n), severity (1-5), biz_impact (low/med/high), suggested_fix. On submit, dp-bot creates a triage card and optional GH issue.
Ben: Prioritization rule (compact & explainable):
```
base = 3 if reproducible == "yes" else 0
impact = 2 if biz_impact == "high" else 1 if biz_impact == "med" else 0
visibility = 1 if user_visible == "yes" else 0
weight = 1.25 if tier == "Partner" else 1.1 if tier == "Pilot" else 1.0
priority = (base + impact + visibility) * weight
```
Map: >=7 -> P0 (eng + 48h triage), 5-6 -> P1, <=4 -> backlog/watch.
Asha: Security override: any PHI/PCI -> auto-escalate to Sec for 48h review and mark urgent regardless of score. Also include KMS checkbox on intake.
Dina: Onboarding cadence: Seed 2wks, Pilot 3wks, Partner 6wks. Checklist: access & keys, sample prompts + eval harness, baseline metrics, e2e smoke, stability window for Partner. I'll draft templates.
Jamal: Launch gates: staging infra SLOs x72h, no quality regression >1% vs partner baseline, partner e2e tests green. If fail -> 3-day hotfix window then re-evaluate.
Asha: Measurements: daily_active_calls, regen_rate, false_positive_rate, p50/p95 latency, partner_nps. Persist evals tagged with partner_id.
Ben: Cost estimate (rough monthly): Seed $50, Pilot $900, Partner $3,900 (credits + SRE amortized). Finance to confirm.
Asha: Action items: @Dina onboarding + intake fields; @Cal runbook template + ops stipend note; @Jamal hook dp-bot exports to GH; @Ben confirm finance. Reconvene Fri to lock terms.
Cal: I'll draft runbook and rollback template by EOD tomorrow.
Dina: Intake form fields + onboarding templates posted later today.
Jamal: I'll wire the triage export and tag automation.
Asha: Thanks everyone  small cohorts, fast feedback, deterministic prioritization. :seedling:
